annotations.title: How well a CV matches a job

description: How well a CV matches a job. For "how well do I match this job?", "should I apply?", "what's missing from my CV for this?". Scores a CV or profile against a job from a search (or pasted advert) out of 100, the same way every time: skills 45, role 20, experience 15, education 10, place 10. Gives matched and missing skills, strengths, gaps and keywords to add if true. Nothing sent is stored. The score is a fixed formula, not an AI judgement; the person decides what to apply for.

cv.description: The CV as plain text. Optional if titles and skills are given.

employers.description: Current and past employers, comma separated.

id.description: A job id from a search result, copied exactly. Or give job_text.

job_text.description: The job advert as plain text, when there is no id.

location.description: Where the person lives or wants to work.

titles.description: Current and past job titles, comma separated.

name: match_cv
title: How well a CV matches a job
